title: Tornado Safety and Preparedness
description: Senior Airman Jared Garrett and Airman 1st Class Danbry Veras demonstrate tornado safety tips to keep Airmen and their families safe in the event of a tornado. Tornado season in Kansas typically starts in April and ends in June, however, tornadoes can occur anytime. (U.S. Air Force video by Airman Paula Arce)
keywords: Tornado Weather Safety Precautions CEX Emergency Management
